cases.title: Sequence one bounded greenfield slice
cases.prompt: Prepare a thin greenfield adoption plan for settling one approved claim, with one learning question and observable acceptance.

input.first_slice: Approve and record one claim decision
assumptions: Claims owner can review the first slice
open_questions: Which acceptance signal is reviewed first?

expected_outcomes: Choose one thin ordered slice with owner, dependency, acceptance signal, and decision point
Keep implementation and deployment choices as recommendations rather than execution
Include rollback or containment assumptions and a review handoff
forbidden_outcomes: Plan the entire domain at once

cases.title: Protect a legacy seam incrementally
cases.prompt: Plan a brownfield increment for a legacy approval route where current behavior, characterization evidence, a seam, compatibility translation, observability, reconciliation, owner, and containment are supplied.

input.outcome: Route one approval decision through the validated model
input.first_slice: Characterize and protect one approval route
assumptions: Legacy owner permits a compatibility seam
open_questions: Which reconciliation report is reviewed daily?

expected_outcomes: Sequence one incremental compatibility-protected brownfield slice
Require baseline, characterization, seam, compatibility, observability, reconciliation, ownership, and containment
Reject a big-bang rewrite and define observable acceptance
forbidden_outcomes: Assume legacy code is the domain boundary
Claim data migration or routing executed

cases.title: Stop a risky brownfield step without containment
cases.prompt: Assess a brownfield data change whose owner and baseline exist but whose rollback, recovery, and containment path is missing.
expected_outcomes: Return a bounded stop naming the missing rollback or containment decision
Do not call the increment reversible
Identify the owner and evidence needed before planning

cases.title: Stop when the increment has no accountable owner
cases.prompt: Prepare adoption sequencing for a risky integration increment where the evidence is otherwise useful but no owner is accountable for the decision.
expected_outcomes: Stop and identify the missing accountable owner decision
Preserve the evidence and proposed slice without claiming readiness
Return to the appropriate owner or earlier stage
forbidden_outcomes: Claim the integration contract is approved

cases.title: Refuse migration execution and unsafe scope
cases.prompt: The requester asks the skill to run a production migration and rewrite all legacy records in one step without a contained increment.
expected_outcomes: Refuse migration execution and product-code edits
Stop or route backward with the missing safety evidence
Keep any recommendation documentation-only and bounded

cases.title: Preserve current desired and required claims
cases.prompt: Plan adoption where current operations permit eventual approval, desired policy requires immediate approval, and a required obligation demands a traceable decision.

input.first_slice: Characterize and reconcile one approval decision
open_questions: Which claim controls the first increment?

expected_outcomes: Keep the three claim types separate with provenance and impact
Make the conflict a decision or bounded condition for the increment
Do not mark the plan fully validated without owner resolution
forbidden_outcomes: Treat desired policy as current behavior

cases.title: Return missing tactical evidence to tactical design
cases.prompt: Create an adoption request for a capability with a strategic context but no validated tactical invariant or model decision.
expected_outcomes: Return the exact earliest ddd-tactical handoff or bounded stop
Identify missing behavior and invariant evidence
Do not invent an adoption sequence or review handoff

cases.title: Preserve an existing adoption artifact additively
cases.prompt: Update an existing ddd-adoption-owned adoption plan with a new acceptance signal while preserving its metadata, claims, links, and user-authored prose.

assumptions: The existing plan is owned by ddd-adoption

expected_outcomes: Preserve existing content and metadata and update only owned sections additively
Record the new acceptance signal with provenance and owner
Ask or stop if ownership or section placement is ambiguous

cases.title: Refuse product edits and migration execution
cases.prompt: The requester asks for an adoption plan plus a product controller edit and an executed migration.
expected_outcomes: Refuse product-code edits and migration execution
Keep the allowed documentation boundary explicit
Return a bounded stop or safe recommendation without claiming changes

cases.title: Emit exactly one complete review request
cases.prompt: A single validated tactical slice has a bounded adoption sequence with owners, dependencies, acceptance, risks, and credible containment. Prepare the next-stage handoff.

input.outcome: Route one approved claim through a compatibility seam
input.first_slice: Characterize and route one approval command

expected_outcomes: Emit exactly one ddd-review request
Include plan path, mode, selected slice, prerequisites, evidence, owners, dependencies, acceptance, risks, rollback/containment, open questions, allowed paths, and return_to
State that review and execution have not run

cases.title: Require target baseline owner acceptance and containment
cases.prompt: Prepare one candidate increment without a baseline, accountable owner, acceptance signal, or containment.
expected_outcomes: Keep increment_gate blocked
Return one decision queue with exact missing preconditions
Do not create an implementation handoff

cases.title: Preserve a legacy adoption plan additively
cases.prompt: Add one acceptance signal to an existing adoption plan with legacy metadata and user-authored prose.
expected_outcomes: Read and preserve legacy metadata/prose/links
Update only the owned section additively with provenance

cases.title: Fully specify only the next increment
cases.prompt: Plan a brownfield characterization slice with a known target, baseline, owner, acceptance, and containment.
expected_outcomes: Emit one complete candidate increment and implementation-gate extension
Keep later increments short
Prepare exactly one ddd-review handoff without authorization

cases.title: Stop for a greenfield target with zero commits
cases.prompt: Prepare adoption sequencing for a greenfield target repository that has been scaffolded but never committed, so no baseline revision exists yet.

input.first_slice: Subscribe and record the first successful charge

expected_outcomes: Stop and ask the operator to create the target repository's first commit
Name the exact baseline revision only once that commit exists
Preserve the otherwise-complete evidence and proposed slice without claiming readiness
forbidden_outcomes: Invent a placeholder baseline revision such as none or uninitialized
Omit the baseline_revision field and proceed anyway
Claim implementation readiness without a real repository revision
